title: Clean log records
prompt: The on-call dashboard should only see log records that parsed. The starter saves the log file; write the rest of `solve(application_logs_raw)` so it reads the file as JSON Lines and returns `log_id`, `logged_at`, `level`, `service` and `message` for every good record.
rules: Columns and types: `log_id STRING, logged_at TIMESTAMP, level STRING, service STRING, message STRING`.
Leave out lines that aren't valid JSON, and records whose `logged_at` isn't a valid timestamp.
A record with a missing field is kept, with NULL for that field. Keep repeated records.
Return only these five columns, in this order.
hints: `spark.read.json(path, schema=...)` reads JSON Lines with the types you give.
Only the fields named in the schema are read; the others are ignored.
`mode="DROPMALFORMED"` leaves out the lines that don't fit.
starter:
def solve(application_logs_raw):
    path = "/tmp/logs/app"
    application_logs_raw.write.mode("overwrite").text(path)
    # Read the file at `path` as JSON Lines and return the good records.
    return application_logs_raw
